name: Ramos.2022.PeerJ_Environmental.Variables.2013
description: Environmental Variables created/measured by EFForTS subprojects other than Z02 Those Variables are: Mean Temperature, Mean Humidity, Canopy Openness, Aboveground Biomass, PLant species per plot, Trees per plot, Stand Structural Complexity Index (SSCI). Data is per EFForTS Plot. Citations/sources for data in Main Manuscript (Ramos et al 2022, Rainforest conversion to rubber and oil palm reduces abundances and diversity of canopy spiders, PeerJ)
